Coram : MADAN B. LOKUR*, KURIAN JOSEPH
c Service Law- Switch-over option from CPF to Pension/ GPF Scheme - Whether the respondents were entitled, as of right, to one more opportunity to switch-over from the Contributory Provident Fund (CPF) Scheme of which they were members, to the Pension Scheme and the General D Provident implemented by the appellant - Held: Entitlement to pension was available to the respondents but they chose not to avail the entitlement for reasons personal to them - Having taken a decision in this regard, the respondents cannot now raise an argument E of pension not being a bounty and therefore
